optimization-iteration.name: rust-opt-level-2
optimization-iteration.rationale: Measure optimized code-size versus inlining tradeoff for JSON/XML-heavy Rust supervisor; engine binary is unchanged.
optimization-iteration.phase_basis: Historical and preceding per-game profiles show IPC/serialization/hash/validation allocations on measured path; candidate targets Rust runner instruction/cache cost

diff --git a/tools/bot-evaluation/Cargo.toml b/tools/bot-evaluation/Cargo.toml index 19f70ec9..7cbae637 100644 --- a/tools/bot-evaluation/Cargo.toml +++ b/tools/bot-evaluation/Cargo.toml @@ -14,5 +14,6 @@ libxml = "0.3.23" time = { version = "0.3", features = ["formatting"] }
[profile.release] +opt-level = 2 lto = "thin" codegen-units = 1
